canonicalTunables.description: time between shots (cadence); the spine of weapon feel
latency from fire input onset to an explicit projectile-spawn signal
time to kill the reference enemy
per-shot recoil kick in degrees (no supported angular unit today — left unitless)
aim-down-sights / focus transition time (side-scroll + twin-stick aim modes)
screen-shake amplitude on fire / hit / kill
hit-stop freeze on impact / kill for weight

defaultBands.calculator: screen-shake amplitude from camera-transform sampling (none today)
hit-stop window from time-scale / motion-pause sampling (none today)

band.qualitative: responsive, fair, and readable at twin-stick + side-scroll aim ranges

notes: twitch shooter feel. Bands are pack-default/exemplar-set; inputToSfxLatency, fireIntervalMs, fireInputToSpawnLatency, projectileSpeed, and ttkMs are verifiable today when the weapon exposes a sampled SFX/fire/spawn counter, the projectile can be bound as the measured trajectory subject, or the reference enemy exposes sampled hit/death signals (ttkMs is measured first-hit→death, independent of aim time). screen-shake / hit-stop are tagged needs-new-calculator; automatic runtime-spawned object discovery remains separate from the explicit spawn-signal metric. aiming-feel is judgment-only and pairs with a humanOracleCheck in the contract. recoilKickDeg has no supported angular unit today, so it is seeded unitless.
